# Third-party research references

VizLens V0.2 is a fresh implementation. No third-party runtime code from the research projects below is bundled.

## D3 Deconstructor

Conceptual inspiration: **D3 Deconstructor**, UC Berkeley VisLab (2014), BSD 3-Clause.

The original project demonstrated extraction of D3-bound data, mark attributes and inferred mappings from SVG visualizations. VizLens reimplements those ideas with Manifest V3 MAIN-world execution and broadens the scanner to modern visualization runtimes, article context, local visual planning and VizForge handoff.

The original BSD 3-Clause license is reproduced in `D3_DECONSTRUCTOR_LICENSE.txt` for attribution/reference.

## Opera browser CLI (user-provided archive)

The attached `opera-browser-cli-main.zip` is MIT licensed. VizLens reviewed its agent-ergonomic ideas — compact accessibility snapshots, eval, screenshots and network-oriented inspection. No source file from the archive is bundled into VizLens V0.2.

## Lynx (user-provided archive)

The attached `Lynx-master.zip` identifies most of the Lynx release as distributed under GNU GPL Version 2 terms, with additional copyright terms in `COPYHEADER`. VizLens does not copy or link Lynx code. It borrows only the product idea of a compact semantic/text reading surface.
